description: Sends a proposal for a design library or tool to the Minerals curator. Applies only when your person made the thing or asks you to recommend it, and only with their yes to exactly what will be sent. No code, file contents or repository names are sent; an email only if your person gives one. Returns one line that says the request was sent.

goes_well_with.description: Up to three refs of published listings it works well beside.

install_address.description: The address an agent pulls from, if there is one.

licence_and_free.description: Its licence, and what is free.

link.description: The address of the library or tool.

moment.description: When would someone reach for this? One of: Starting, Building a section, Filling a gap, Polishing, Tuning, Sharing. Leave it out if unsure.
